== 说明 ==
要使用本模板，请添加{{T|{{BASEPAGENAME}}}}模板并填写对应字段。留空的字段不会在文章中显示。本信息框模板使用[[w:Help:Infobox|Fandom 信息框语法]]。

== 语法 ==
<pre>
{{Album
 | title         = 
 | image         = [例如「Example.jpg」]
 | imagecaption  = 
 | artist        = 
 | released      = 
 | recorded      = 
 | length        = 
 | label         = 
 | producer      = 
}}
</pre>

== 示例效果 ==
{{Album
 | title         = Fleur
 | image         = Example.jpg
 | artist        = Marigold
 | released      = June 2012
 | recorded      = 2011
 | length        = 88:88
 | label         = Spring
 | producer      = Daffy
}}
